caption:
Palette Study No. 01: the quiet greige. A colour palette that makes a room read expensive without one costly purchase in it.

Walls carry the 60. Greige takes the 30. Aged brass gets the last 10, and that restraint is most of the trick.

Hex codes are on the slides. Save this for the repaint.
